snippet.title: Defender of Darkness — Official Trailer
snippet.description:
You are the Dark Lord, the last defender of an alliance of dark lords under siege by the merciless armies of light. Two lords are under attack, but you can save only one. Who will you leave to fall?

Defender of Darkness combines autobattles, tower defense and spell-card deckbuilding.

• Prepare your defenses before combat: build towers, camps and each lord’s unique buildings.
• Summon powerful mythics with gold earned in battle.
• Build your deck from 100 spells.
• Adapt your tactics to more than 150 enemy types.

Every rescued lord will bring an army to the assault on the Citadel of Light. Keep as many allies alive as you can — then lead the forces of darkness on the offensive.

Play Defender of Darkness on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4869280/Defender_of_Darkness/

#DefenderOfDarkness #TowerDefense #DarkFantasy #IndieGame
